name: Grocery run
summary: A shared grocery list with an urgency meter; one person takes the run and ticks items into the cart.
useWhen: housemates listing what the place is out of
'we're out of eggs', 'who's going to trader joe's', 'add oat milk'
dontUseWhen: splitting what a shop cost (use a bill split)
deciding who brings what to a party (use potluck or a bring list)

messages.description: How many chat messages the list came from, 0 if unknown

who.description: Who asked, as in the chat

priceCents.description: Estimated price in cents, 0 if unknown

begging.description: Name of whoever is asking hardest, or empty
